messages.subject: Histogram issues
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have some issues with ggplot trying to build histograms.

Here is my code :

###classic
hist(data2$Marmo,main = "A. marmorata", xlab = "Total Lenght", ylab = "Count")

###ggplot
m <- ggplot(data2, aes(x=Marmo))
m + geom_histogram(colour="black", fill="white", binwidth=1)+ ylab("Count") + xlab("Total Lenght") + ggtitle(bquote(atop(.("A. marmorata")))) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(42,56,by=2)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.title=element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold"), panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom")

See the figures attached.

Histograms are completely different !
I don't understand why, could you ?

Thank you

messages.author: 6ae5f78675aa0940
messages.subject: RE: Histogram issues
parts:
Without the specific data, hard to say. However, probably has to do with different assumptions re a) how to handle values that fall exactly on a break (do they go in left or right bar relative to the break?). Or possibly different bin widths. Both can be explored as seen here:

http://www.r-bloggers.com/basics-of-histograms/

Seth

messages.author: 6ae5f78675aa0940
messages.subject: RE: Histogram issues
parts:
Thank you for providing the data.     As suspected, it has to do with how the bin functions for each handle values that are exactly on the breaks.  This is controlled by “right=[logical]”.

 

Your original code for base graphics was

###classic

hist(data2$Marmo,main = "A. marmorata", xlab = "Total Lenght", ylab = "Count")

#But changing it to

hist(data2$Marmo,main = "A. marmorata", xlab = "Total Lenght", ylab = "Count", right=F)  #Now the histogram shape is the same as the ggplot version.

 

 

Conversely  taking the ggplot2 version:

 

#original

m <- ggplot(data2, aes(x=Marmo))

m + geom_histogram(colour="black", fill="white", binwidth=1)+ ylab("Count") + xlab("Total Lenght") + ggtitle(bquote(atop(.("A. marmorata")))) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(42,56,by=2)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.title=element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold"), panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom")

#And adding “right=T” inside geom_histogram() makes it the same as the base graphics version.:

 

m + geom_histogram(colour="black", fill="white", binwidth=1,right=T)+ ylab("Count") + xlab("Total Lenght") + ggtitle(bquote(atop(.("A. marmorata")))) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(42,56,by=2)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.title=element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold"), panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom")

 

 

--Seth
